title: Multi-modal 3D image reconstruction using M²aia software
author: Jonas Cordes
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bvq8n5zw

steps.title: Configure M²aia Software Preferences
steps.instruction: Set the executable paths for elastix and transformix within the software preferences.

substeps.instruction: Open Preferences via Window > Preferences or Ctrl+P
Select the M²aia preference page
Set the paths to the elastix and transformix executables

steps.title: Configure Data View Settings
steps.instruction: Adjust the Imaging tab settings in the Data view.

substeps.instruction: Open the Data view via Window > Show View > Data
Open the Imaging tab
Enable TIC normalization
Disable smoothing
Disable baseline correction

steps.title: Load Lipid and Peptide Datasets
steps.instruction: Import all lipid and peptide files into M²aia, ensuring all *.nrrd and *.ibd files are in the same directory level.

substeps.instruction: Load lipid files via File > Open File or Ctrl + O
Load peptide files via File > Open File or Ctrl + O

steps.title: Setup Standard Display for 2D Visualization
steps.instruction: Optional: Configure the display to visualize multiple datasets.

substeps.instruction: Open the Options tab in the Data view
Set Rows to 4 in the Tile images box and click Apply
Maximize the top view display by clicking the blue square at the top right of the display menu

steps.title: Generate Ion Images
steps.instruction: Create ion images based on specific m/z values.

substeps.instruction: Open the Data view (Window > Show View > Data or Data view tab)
Navigate to the Ion imaging box
Create ion images at m/z 2250 +/- 50 Da and m/z 865 +/- 50 ppm

steps.title: Pre-align Images
steps.instruction: Optional: Align images to increase registration accuracy.

substeps.instruction: Open the Position view (Window > Show View > Position)
Open the Data Manager view (Window > Show View > Data Manager)
Select image nodes in the Data Manager and use the Position view to align the images

steps.title: Perform 3D Reconstruction Stacking
steps.instruction: Stack peptide and lipid images to create 3D nodes.

substeps.instruction: Open the Reconstruction 3D view (Window > Show View > Reconstruction 3D)
Select the Image selection tab
Drag and drop all peptide images into the right table
Select a reference slice in the left table (containing lipid images)
Click 'Start stacking' and monitor progress in the console window
Verify that two new nodes (Stack_0 for lipids, Stack_1 for peptides) appear in the Data Manager

steps.title: Manage Render Windows and Nodes
steps.instruction: Adjust the view and initialize the image stack nodes.

substeps.instruction: Minimize the top view by clicking the blue square at the top right of the display menu to see all render windows
Select one or both image stack nodes in the Data Manager
Right-click the node(s) and perform a Reinit and select 'Show only selected nodes'

steps.title: Perform 3D Ion Imaging
steps.instruction: Execute 3D ion imaging using the specified initialization settings.

substeps.instruction: In the Data view, select the Initialization tab and enable 'Only visible'
Perform 3D ion imaging using the Spectrum view or the Ion imaging utilities
